\begin{document}
The pulse is linearly chirped,
\begin{equation}
\omega(t) = \omega_0 + \alpha t ,
\label{eq:w}
\end{equation}
and the photon energy is $\hbar$ times the time derivative of the phase,
\begin{equation}
\hbar \frac{d(\omega t)}{dt} = \hbar\omega .
\label{eq:chirp}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
